glossary.definition: (C) The program shall permit the business logo signs of a seller of motor vehicle fuel to include on the seller's signs a marking or symbol indicating that the seller sells one or more types of alternative fuel so long as the seller in fact sells that fuel. As used in this division, "alternative fuel" has the same meaning as in section 125.831 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 5537.30 - Program for the placement of business logos for identification purposes on directional signs within the turnpike right-of-way.
